Monitoring reports

Stored daily, weekly and monthly summaries of the monitors — availability, min/avg/peak per metric, breaches, drift events and change against the previous period — that you can generate, schedule, download and mail.

👤 ForViewerOperatorAdministrator
🔑 Permissionsmonitoring.view operations.apply appliances.apply
📍 WhereMonitoring → Reports (every ADOM) (URL /monitoring/reports/)

What is it?#

A monitoring report is a stored summary of one complete period — a day, an ISO week (Monday to Sunday) or a calendar month, in UTC — built from the probe samples and roll-ups and from the local metrics store. Reports are stored, not recomputed when you open them: raw samples expire, and a summary rebuilt months later would silently use coarser data.

ℹ️Note

This page is about monitoring summaries. For SQL-style reports over the SATOM database see Database tools; for user-submitted problem reports see Bug reports.

What does it do?#

  • Recurring reports strip: for Daily, Weekly and Monthly, shows whether a monitor_report scheduled action is armed (with next run), disabled or not scheduled.
  • Generate a report now (build and store) or Preview (build without storing).
  • Lists up to 200 stored reports with Report, Period, Devices, Probes, Samples, Health, Worst, Incidents, Mailed, and actions Download CSV, Download JSON, Email this report, Delete.
  • The report page shows Health, Worst status, Samples, Incidents, Drift events (daemon restarts, interface changes), Silent probes (reported nothing in the window), a per-probe table (Min, Avg, p95, Peak, vs prev, Health, Samples, Source), Probes that reported nothing, the incidents list and a Fleet metrics (metrics store) section (see below). Text and CSV buttons export it.

Requirements#

  • Probes with samples in the period (see Probes).
  • For recurring reports: monitor_report scheduled actions. SATOM creates them with its default set when the node gets its first appliance; sudo satom execute seed actions --yes fills any gap. The set holds daily (02:00), weekly (Monday 02:10) and monthly (1st, 02:20) reports with mail, off-box copy and retention (90 / 53 / 36 reports).
  • For Email this report: SMTP configured and a recipient (see Configuration).

Permissions#

🔑Permission

  • Reading, downloading, Preview: the legacy view gate — any read permission, for example monitoring.view; all system profiles have it.
  • Build and store, Email this report, Delete: the legacy config_write gate (e.g. operations.apply or appliances.apply). Without it the Generate a report now box is not shown and the endpoints return 403.
  • Scoping: the Global ADOM sees every report; a product ADOM sees only reports generated in that ADOM. Scheduled reports are generated for Global unless the action carries a product parameter.

ℹ️Note

Changed in 2.11.0: reading monitoring reports now requires a read permission instead of sign-in alone, and the fleet metrics section is shown on the report page, in the text / e-mail body and in the CSV, not only in the JSON.

How to use#

Generate a report now#

  1. Open Monitoring → Reports.
  2. Under Generate a report now choose Period and Which one: The last complete one, The one before that, Three back, or The current, incomplete one.
  3. Click Build and store — or Preview to see it without storing.

Building the same period again replaces the stored report for that period and ADOM.

Read, export, mail, delete#

  • Click a report title to open it; Text and CSV download it, All reports returns to the list.
  • The Fleet metrics (metrics store) card lists, per metric and series, the Min, Avg and Max over the period, then Policies down in the window (Global and FortiWeb ADOMs) and Failing collectors with their device names. If the metrics store could not be reached when the report was built, the card says Not available: with the reason instead of showing empty figures. Reports stored before 2.11.0 may have no fleet section.
  • In the list, use Download CSV, Download JSON, Email this report or Delete.

Schedule recurring reports#

Create a Monitoring report — period summary (monitor_report) action in Scheduled actions after the period closes — daily at about 02:00, weekly on Monday, monthly on the 1st.

Configuration#

monitor_report action parameters:

Parameter Description Required Example
period daily, weekly or monthly (default daily) No weekly
offset Which period back; 1 = last complete one (0–60) No 1
email 1/true to mail the stored report No 1
push_server 1/true to upload the summary (JSON and text) to the external backup server No 1
keep Keep only the newest N reports of this period No 90
product ADOM the report is generated for (empty = Global) No fortiweb

Recipients, in order: setting reports.email_to, then the alert recipients (alerts.email_to), then the e-mail default recipients. Only the latter two have fields on Settings → Email & Alerts.

Example#

🧪Example — A weekly report for management

Create a weekly monitor_report action on Monday 02:10 with period=weekly, email=1, keep=53. Every Monday the previous ISO week is stored and mailed as plain text; the CSV and JSON are available on the page.

Result#

  • Generating from the page writes an audit entry report.generate; mailing writes report.email; deleting writes report.delete.
  • A mailed report shows mailed <time>.
  • A mail or off-box failure does not fail the scheduled action; the report is already stored and the action summary says email FAILED (…).

Troubleshooting#

"Nothing is scheduled for Daily, Weekly, Monthly."#

No monitor_report action exists. Arm them in Automation or with satom execute seed actions.

"No recipients configured (reports.email_to / alerts.email_to / email.default_to)."#

Set the alert recipients or the e-mail default recipients on Settings → Email & Alerts.

"SMTP is not configured."#

Configure SMTP on Settings → Email & Alerts and use Send test first.

"Nothing was measured in this window."#

No probe produced samples in the period. Check that the deep_monitor sweep is running and probes exist; the report says no data rather than a healthy zero.

A report is missing in a product ADOM#

Reports built in Global (including scheduled ones by default) are only listed in Global.

Advanced#

Advanced What a report contains
  • Totals: devices, probes, samples, healthy %, worst status (an unmeasured device ranks below ok, so "no data" never rolls up to "ok"), incidents.
  • Per probe: min / avg / p95 / peak, change against the preceding period, and the data source used.
  • A fleet section computed from the metrics store (min/avg/max per device per metric for the report's ADOM, policies down, failing collectors). It is stored in the JSON (and the off-box copy) and rendered on the report page and in the text / e-mail body. The CSV carries it as extra rows: kind fleet (one per metric and series, source metrics_store), fleet_policy_down and fleet_collector_failed.
  • Periods are half-open windows in UTC, so two adjacent reports never share a bucket.
